rules.title: Prohibition on Landlord Application and Screening Fees
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from charging prospective tenants application fees, pet fees, cleaning fees, amenity fees, or any other upfront charges besides first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit, and a lock-change fee.
rules.exemptions: Licensed brokers may charge fees under specific regulatory conditions.
rules.quoted_span: It states that prior to the beginning of a tenancy, no lessor may require payment for anything except first, last, security, and locks ( MGL Ch 186 Section 15B ).
